jobs.text:
🏷️ Construction & Engineering

🏢 Company: Kubik Ethiopia
🏬 About: Kubik Ethiopia is a manufacturing company specializing in plastic recycling and related machinery.

💼 Positions:
1. Horizontal Baler Operator
   📍 Location: Harar and Dire Dawa
   🎓 Requirements:
   - COC certification
   - Ability to read and prepare drawings
   - Hands‑on experience in plastic recycling machinery maintenance
   - Critical thinker and problem‑solving skills
   - Good time‑management skills
   - Electrical knowledge is a plus
   - Qualification: TVET/Diploma or above in General Mechanics, Fabrication or related field, or BSc Degree in Mechanical Engineering
   - Experience: 3+ years in the manufacturing industry as a mechanic; experience in plastic manufacturing preferred

📊 Vacancy Count: 1
📅 Deadline: Oct 29, 2026
